title.en: AllenAI publishes ToyBlocks robotics demonstration data
title.zhHans: AllenAI 发布 ToyBlocks 机器人演示数据

searchSummary.en: AllenAI’s November 6 report describes an initial ToyBlocks dataset; Hugging Face lists the public dataset, not proof of external training outcomes.
searchSummary.zhHans: AllenAI 于 11 月 6 日介绍首批 ToyBlocks 数据；Hugging Face 列出公开数据集，但这不证明外部训练成效。

summary.en: An AllenAI article dated November 6 describes the initial ToyBlocks simulated robotics dataset as 85,336 long-horizon demonstrations covering nearly 1,600 hours. A public Hugging Face dataset listing and card show available data artifacts and an ODC-BY license. These scale figures are author-reported, not independently audited. A larger second dataset and integrated reinforcement-learning training were presented as future work, not available in the initial package.
summary.zhHans: AllenAI 日期为 11 月 6 日的文章称，首批 ToyBlocks 模拟机器人数据包含 85,336 条长任务演示、接近 1,600 小时。Hugging Face 的公开数据集列表及说明卡显示数据文件可获取，并标注 ODC-BY 许可。规模数字由发布方提供，并未独立审计。更大规模的第二批数据和集成强化学习训练属于后续计划，不在首批交付范围内。

narrative.en: This is an accessible research-data release, not a claim that real-world robot skills improved or a second release already occurred. The repository was created November 5; the dated public article is November 6, and first public download is not known.
narrative.zhHans: 节点记录研究数据可获取，不声称真实机器人技能已提升或第二批数据已发布。仓库创建于 11 月 5 日，公开文章日期为 11 月 6 日，首次对外下载时间仍未知。

text.en: AllenAI published a November 6 ToyBlocks data-release account, and Hugging Face lists the public dataset; the stated 85,336 demonstrations are provider-reported.
text.zhHans: AllenAI 于 11 月 6 日发表 ToyBlocks 数据发布说明，Hugging Face 列出公开数据集；85,336 条演示的数字来自发布方。

text.en: AllenAI described larger-scale data and integrated RL training as future additions; no independent performance gain is established by the current dataset.
text.zhHans: AllenAI 将更大规模数据和集成强化学习训练列为未来补充；当前数据集不证明性能增益已获独立验证。
